source.label: アプティブ 10-K(2025-12-31)

relations.text: 2020年3月に自動運転技術を手がける合弁会社モーショナルを共同で設立した
relations.text_en: In March 2020 the two formed Motional, a joint venture for autonomous driving technologies

source.label: アプティブ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In March 2020, we completed a transaction with Hyundai Motor Group (“Hyundai”) to form Motional AD LLC (“Motional”), a joint venture focused on the design, development and commercialization of autonomous driving technologies.

relations.text: 2025年5月の追加出資で、モーショナルの普通株持分は約13%まで下がった
relations.text_en: After Hyundai's additional funding in May 2025, Aptiv's common equity interest in Motional fell to approximately 13%

source.label: アプティブ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In May 2025, Hyundai provided additional funding to Motional, further reducing Aptiv’s common equity interest in Motional from 15% as of March 31, 2025 to approximately 13% as of December 31, 2025.
